methodologyNotes: The roster covers 13 distinct mesh Wi-Fi systems spanning Wi-Fi 6 through Wi-Fi 7, drawn from high-search consumer models in 2022-2025. Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product/spec pages (eero.com, store.google.com, netgear.com, tp-link.com, asus.com, store.ui.com / techspecs.ui.com) and corroborated by review outlets (Dong Knows Tech, Tom's Guide, Tom's Hardware, Android Central, BroadbandNow). max_speed_gbps reflects the manufacturer's aggregate theoretical Wi-Fi throughput across all bands. dedicated_backhaul is true ONLY when a radio band or wired path is reserved exclusively for node-to-node communication per the strict definition; mesh systems that use adaptive/dynamic backhaul where every band remains available to clients (eero TrueMesh, Google Nest Wifi Pro) are marked false even though they backhaul wirelessly. coverage_sqft_per_pack is the manufacturer's stated figure for the noted pack size. Prices are the published US price for the exact config named as of access. accessedAt 2026-06-19. Adversarial corrections this pass: eero Pro 6E / eero Max 7 / Google Nest Wifi Pro dedicated_backhaul true->false (no band reserved exclusively); Deco BE85 coverage 7500->9600 sq ft and release 2023-05->2023-04; Orbi RBK763S price null->399.99 (published US price confirmed). All 13 products exist and were retained.

products.name: Amazon eero 6+ (3-pack)
products.provenance: Verified from eero.com and eero blog: dual-band Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5 GHz, 160 MHz in 5 GHz), wired/wireless speeds up to ~1 Gbps, two auto-sensing gigabit Ethernet ports per unit, 4,500 sq ft for 3-pack. Launch MSRP $299.99 (3-pack). Released March 2022 alongside eero Pro 6E per eero's own launch announcement. Dual-band with no exclusively reserved backhaul band -> dedicated_backhaul false (unchanged).

products.name: Amazon eero Pro 6E (3-pack)
products.provenance: Verified from eero.com: tri-band Wi-Fi 6E (2.4/5/6 GHz, 160 MHz), network speeds up to 2.3 Gbps, one 2.5 GbE + one 1 GbE port per unit, 6,000 sq ft (3-pack). eero.com shop page shows 3-pack list $449.99 marked down to $329.99 (current price confirmed via Best Buy/SlickDeals) - price and priceNote retained as accurate. CORRECTED dedicated_backhaul true->false: eero/Help and reviews (BroadbandNow, Android Central) confirm the 6 GHz band is NOT reserved as a dedicated backhaul - all three bands remain available to clients and backhaul is adaptive (TrueMesh), so it does not meet the 'reserved exclusively' definition. Released March 2022.

products.name: Amazon eero Max 7
products.provenance: Verified from eero.com and TechCrunch: tri-band Wi-Fi 7 (2.4/5/6 GHz), wireless up to 4.3 Gbps, wired up to 9.4 Gbps. Each unit has two 10 GbE + two 2.5 GbE = 4 ports. 3-pack covers 7,500 sq ft (2,500 sq ft/unit). $599.99 per unit / $1,699.99 3-pack confirmed via Newegg/eero. Available Oct 26, 2023. CORRECTED dedicated_backhaul true->false: eero uses adaptive multi-band/MLO backhaul with no band reserved exclusively for node-to-node traffic, so it does not meet the strict definition.

products.name: Google Nest Wifi Pro
products.provenance: Verified via Google Store specs and Google Home support: AXE5400 tri-band Wi-Fi 6E (2.4/5/6 GHz), combined up to 5.4 Gbps, 2 Ethernet ports per unit (both 1 GbE). ~2,200 sq ft/unit, 6,600 sq ft for 3-pack. $199.99 single / $399.99 3-pack confirmed. Released Oct 27, 2022. CORRECTED dedicated_backhaul true->false: Google support explicitly states there is no dedicated wireless backhaul channel; the system uses shared bands or wired Ethernet backhaul, so no band is reserved exclusively.

products.name: Amazon eero 7
products.priceNote: eero.com and Newegg list price, 3-pack ($349.99); eero.com also lists 2-pack $279.99 and 1-pack $169.99
products.provenance: Re-verified from eero.com/shop/eero-7 (official; canonical page resolved via www.eero.com after a transient 502 on the bare domain). The page states: eero 7 "supports the Wi-Fi 7 standard" with "multi-link operation (MLO)", "two auto-sensing 2.5 GbE ports and wireless speeds up to 1.8 Gbps", and "each router providing 2,000 sq. ft. of coverage"; PACK SIZE pricing "3-pack $349.99 / 2-pack $279.99 / 1-pack $169.99". This supports wifi_standard=wifi_7, max_speed_gbps=1.8, ethernet_ports_per_unit=2, pack_size=3, priceUsd=349.99, and coverage_sqft_per_pack=6000 (3 x 2,000 sq ft). Corroborated by Newegg, which lists the exact model "EERO 7, Dual-Band mesh Wi-Fi 7 Router, Pack of 3" (Model # B0C6RBS846) at "Covered Area: 6,000 sq. ft.", "Wi-Fi Standards: Wi-Fi 7", "$349.99" — explicitly confirming bands=dual and the 6,000 sq ft 3-pack coverage. Exact-model check passed: distinct from the sibling eero Pro 7 (Tri-Band, 2x5GbE) and eero Max 7 (Tri-Band) also present in the Newegg listing. dedicated_backhaul=false is retained as a direct entailment of the explicitly-confirmed dual-band designation (a two-band mesh cannot reserve a band exclusively for backhaul; eero uses adaptive TrueMesh, named on the page). releaseDate and release left null: no fetched page stated an eero 7 launch date.

products.name: Netgear Orbi 770 (RBE773)
products.priceNote: MSRP $699.99 for the 3-pack (RBE773). NETGEAR.com shows "$699.99 original price" with a "$629.99 current price" promo; Newegg lists $699.99. Amazon (RBE773) had no featured offer at access.
products.provenance: Verified from NETGEAR's RBE773 product page and the Newegg RBE773-100NAS listing: BE11000 tri-band WiFi 7 (IEEE 802.11be; 6 GHz 5,760 + 5 GHz 4,320 + 2.4 GHz 688 Mbps, 6 streams), maximum WiFi speed "up to 11 Gbps", coverage "up to 8,000 sq. ft." as a 3-pack (one RBE771 router + two RBE770 satellites), up to 100 devices, one 2.5 Gig (2500 Mbps) Multi-Gig WAN port. Ethernet per NETGEAR/Newegg: router has 1x 2.5G WAN + 3x 2.5G LAN (Newegg "Number of Network (RJ-45) Ports: 3", "Total Number of Network Ports: 4") and each satellite has 2x 2.5G LAN; ethernet_ports_per_unit set to 3 per catalog methodology (router LAN count as representative unit), matching the RBK763S treatment. dedicated_backhaul set FALSE despite NETGEAR's "dedicated backhaul / Enhanced Backhaul" marketing: Newegg's tech spec states the MLO backhaul is "shared 5GHz & 6GHz" with fronthaul also on 5/6 GHz, so no band is reserved exclusively for node-to-node traffic — the adaptive/shared-band case the methodology marks false (same as eero TrueMesh and Google Nest Wifi Pro). Price $699.99 MSRP (NETGEAR original price and Newegg both $699.99; NETGEAR current promo $629.99); Newegg's "First Listed on Newegg October 09, 2024" supports the 2024 release year.

No fetched page states an explicit release/launch date (the only year present is a 2024 award), so releaseDate and the release spec are left null. All 7 non-null spec values, priceUsd, and releaseDate confirmed verbatim against the fetched text; exact model (Deco BE63, 3-pack) confirmed on both pages.
